name: lumen-tiny-mind-v2
lines: lumen is a browser desktop mock with original glass chrome and liquid style surfaces
aura is a local helper loaded at boot that can use a tiny bigram model plus optional public AI
open files to browse the mock volume and documents
open notes to write text stored in this browser local storage
open gallery to add mock apps to the dock
press command space or control space to talk to aura
press f3 for mission control and f4 for launchpad
glass tint and brightness live in the control center
wallpaper scenes cycle with command w or control w
this page is entertainment only and not an apple product or macos
icons here are original svg marks inspired by system style but not official
ask for the time the date a small math problem or to open an app
reminders and notes stay on this device in local storage
the tiny mind is a bigram model trained on these lines at boot
liquid glass uses backdrop filter blur and subtle highlights
dock icons magnify on hover with neighbor scaling
aura can speak responses using the browser speech synthesis
mic button listens with the browser speech recognition when allowed
settings can turn the optional third party text demo on or off
lock the desktop with command l or control l
